title: Stardust Meadows Server Modpack
description: This is the official modpack for the Stardust Meadows Sever!
body:
**Hello Miners and Crafters!**

This is the official modpack for the Stardust Meadows Server! If you would like to use this modpack for your own survival world that is awesome! If you are looking for a server to join, we would love to have some new friends!! Our server can also be found under the Server section here on Modrinth! Or you can just click [here](https://modrinth.com/server/stardust-meadows-server)! 

We use Bloom for some varied World Generation! Dungeons and Taverns and Structory for some new structures, and challenges! Farmers Delight, Traveler's Backpack, PolyDecorations, and Plushables add some fun, new, useful things to the world! 

Also want to say a huge thank you to all of the mod creators, you make the minecraft experience feel like new again!! <3
